name: Lemon Blueberry Cream Pie
subtitle: A favorite of many, including a very young Levi

macros.basis: per slice, 1 of 8, without whipped cream
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: Have a fully pre-baked 8-inch pie crust ready and cooled before you start.
Zest the lemon before you juice it.
notes: This pie is just the right texture with 4 Tbsp of cornstarch instead of 3 (discovered and revised 4/23). The lemon juice goes in after cooking because acid boiled with cornstarch weakens its thickening.

steps.title: Sugar and cornstarch
steps.body: In a saucepan, combine **1 cup sugar + 4 Tbsp cornstarch**.

steps.title: Add the rest of the base
steps.body: Add **1 cup milk + 3 beaten egg yolks + ¼ cup butter + 1 Tbsp grated lemon peel**.

steps.title: Cook until thick
steps.body: Cook and stir on medium heat until thick, then **2 min** more.

steps.title: Lemon juice
steps.body: Off the heat, stir in **¼ cup lemon juice**.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Refrigerate until cool, about **1 hr**. Press plastic wrap on the surface to keep a skin from forming.

steps.title: Sour cream and berries
steps.body: Stir in **1 cup sour cream**, then gently fold in **2 cups blueberries**.

steps.title: Fill and chill
steps.body: Spread into the pre-baked pie crust and chill about **4 hr**. Serve with whipped cream, if desired.

after: Keeps covered in the fridge for about 3 days.
